messages.text: For a Semiconductor use case involving RFIC validation, where would Signaling / Non-signaling Tester fit in the test workflow?

In an RFIC validation workflow, a Signaling / Non-signaling Tester fits best at the **RF subsystem / wireless device validation stage**, after basic silicon bring-up and RF block characterization, and before formal conformance or volume production test.

Typical placement:

1. **First silicon / bench characterization**  
   Use instruments such as signal generators, spectrum analyzers, VNAs, oscilloscopes, power meters, etc. to validate PLLs, PAs, LNAs, mixers, filters, gain, noise figure, S-parameters, phase noise, output power, EVM, ACLR, etc.

2. **RFIC integrated validation — where the tester fits**  
   Once the RFIC is on an evaluation board, module, reference design, or connected to a baseband/protocol stack, the Signaling / Non-signaling Tester becomes useful.

   - **Non-signaling mode**: fast RF PHY validation without a full protocol connection. Useful for transmitter and receiver measurements such as output power, EVM, spectrum, sensitivity, PER/BLER-style checks, frequency error, and calibration verification.
   - **Signaling mode**: network emulation / callbox use. Useful when the RFIC is part of a modem or wireless device platform and you need to validate behavior under LTE/5G/Wi‑Fi connection conditions, throughput, mobility, desense, multi-radio coexistence, pre-conformance, or application-level behavior.

3. **Pre-conformance / system validation**  
   The tester supports more realistic wireless scenarios before sending the design to certification labs. The knowledge base specifically positions R&S CMX500 as a network emulation and measurement solution for LTE, NR FR1/FR2, signaling, TX measurements, RF testing, pre-conformance, desense, throughput, and non-signaling verification.

4. **Production / manufacturing test**  
   Non-signaling testers such as CMP-class instruments are typically more relevant here because production needs speed, repeatability, parallel RF paths, and limited protocol overhead.

So, in short: **for RFIC validation, the Signaling / Non-signaling Tester is the bridge between raw RF bench characterization and full device/conformance testing.**  
For a bare RFIC, **non-signaling** is usually the primary fit. For an RFIC integrated with baseband and protocol software, **signaling** becomes valuable because the tester can emulate the network and validate real operating behavior.

passages.text:
CMX500 Callbox
[[CMX500 Callbox]] 是 [[CMX500_Callbox]] 簡報中對 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 use-case 定位：用一台 callbox 快速建立 DUT 連線，進行 RF、mobility、application、NTN、WLAN / cellular desense、pre-conformance 與 non-signaling R&D 驗證。

R&S CMX500 › Rear panel interfaces
- LAN：Ethernet RJ-45 connector，1000 Mbps。
- Trigger interfaces：Trig. A、Trig. B，2 × BNC connector，3.3 V TTL；Trig. C、Trig. D、Trig. E，3 × BNC connector，3.3 V TTL；AST Out，1 × BNC connector。
- Flexx Sync interface：for future use；In 為 1 × mini SAS HD connector；Loop 為 2 × mini SAS HD connector；Out 為 1 × mini SAS HD connector。
- Flexx Data interface：for future use；In/Out 各 1 × QSFP-DD connector。
- Flexx IQ interface：for future use；In/Out 各 1 × QSFP-DD connector。
- LAN Switch Subnet Only interface：for future use；port 1、port 2 各 1 × SFP+ connector。
- USB：for keyboard、mouse、USB flash drive；2 × USB 3.1 type A connector。
- HDMI：for external monitor；DisplayPort：for external monitor。

Regulatory test for wireless devices with cellular technology › 重點摘要
- 來源將 wireless products 的 market access approval testing 分成三類：[[Regulatory Compliance Test]]、[[Telecom Industry Certification Test]]、[[Cellular Network Operator Acceptance Test]]。Regulatory compliance 被描述為各區域法律面 market access 的必要條件；industry certification 例子包含 [[GCF]] / Cellular、[[Bluetooth SIG]]、[[FiRa]] / [[UWB]]、[[Wi-Fi Alliance]]；operator acceptance test 例子包含 AT&T、VzW、T-mobile、CMCC。
- 來源主張 wireless products 需要 [[CE marking]] / [[FCC ID]]；test results 是 technical documentation 的一部分，需在產品投放市場前準備、可提供給 surveillance authorities，並自 placed on the market 起保存 10 years。
- 來源列出 Ericsson Mobility Visualizer Jan 2023 的 mobile subscriptions 表，顯示 2022–2028 的 5G subscriptions 由 1046.006 增至 4974.568；但單位與表格數值口徑未在轉檔文字中完整標示。
- [[CE RED 無線設備法規測試]]被整理成四類 essential requirements：Art 3.1a Health & Safety、Art 3.1b EMC、Art 3.2 Radio Spectrum、Art 3.3 Specific topics。來源列出多個 ETSI EN standards，例如 [[EN 300 328]]、[[EN 301 893]]、[[EN 303 687]]、[[EN 301 908-1]]、[[EN 301 908-13]]、[[EN 301 908-24]]、[[EN 301 908-25]]、[[EN 301 489-52]] 等。
- 對 [[5G NR SAR testing]]，來源指出 5G NR network emulator is required to drive EUT to extreme transmission condition，multi-radio UE 的 average-SAR feature 需要 flexible signaling functions，涵蓋 cellular standards、Wi-Fi 與 Bluetooth；來源將 [[R&S CMW500]] / [[R&S CMX500]] 稱為 SAR / HAC signaling solution。
- 對 Art 3.1b EMC，來源指出 EMC tests 需要 radio enabled 與 radio disabled conditions，因此 5G NR 也需要 signaling solution；mobile phone 仍需要 [[Audio Breakthrough]] test，從 GSM 到 VoLTE / VoNR by 5G。來源提到 [[R&S TS9982 EMS Test System]] 與 [[R&S TS9975 EMI Test System]]。
- 對 Art 3.2 Radio Spectrum，來源指出 5G NR specification 包含 FR1 與 FR2；FR1 test setup stays conducted，FR2 test setup becomes radiated；並把 3GPP test cases、CTIA-OTA test cases、TRP / TRS、RSE 測試連到 [[R&S TS8991]] 與 [[R&S TS8996]]。

R&S CMW500 › 支援技術摘要
- [[R&S CMW500]] 在 [[CMW_dat-sw_en_5213-9211-22_v1700]] 中是唯一明確支援 GSM small cell、WCDMA small cell、LTE small cell 的 CMW 型號。
- GSM、NB-IoT、WCDMA、LTE mobile station test 與 NR Sub-6GHz 章節明確標示適用於 [[R&S CMW500]] 與 [[R&S CMW290]]。
- Four RF paths、DAU B450H/I、Digital I/Q 1 to 4 / 5 to 8、Digital I/Q QUAD 章節明確標示 [[R&S CMW500]] 與 [[R&S CMW270]]。
- Bluetooth standard：Bluetooth Core Specification Version 5.0；test standard 包含 RF.TS.5.0.0 與 RF-PHY.TS.5.0.0。
- WLAN 160 MHz bandwidth unit 章節列出 IEEE 802.11a/g/p/n/ac 與 IEEE 802.11ax，bandwidth up to 160 MHz。
- [[CMW-KA096_PanEUNGeCall_TC_Status]] 補充 [[NGeCall over LTE]]、[[IMS eCall]]、[[IVS]]、[[PSAP]]、[[MSD]]、limited service、callback、clear-down、SRVCC handover 等 eCall 測試語境。

CMX500 Callbox › Example Callbox use cases
[[CMX500_Callbox]] 的 Example Callbox use cases 進一步列出：

- R&D verification of new bands。
- Sensitivity testing。
- [[RedCap]]。
- [[CMX500 Desense Testing]]。
- [[3GPP Pre-Conformance Testing]]。
- [[CMX500 SRS RF measurements]]。
- UL MIMO and UL CA RF measurements。
- UL TX Switching。
- [[CMX500 Multi-SIM testing]]。
- High e2e TP testing。
- Non-signaling verification。

R&S CMX500 › 產品定位
依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援最新 3GPP [[5G NR]] technology，適用於 device testing，涵蓋 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]，並支援 non-standalone（NSA）、standalone（SA）、FDD 與 TDD。

依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 也提供：

- [[NR FR1]] / [[NR FR2]] signaling 與 TX measurements。
- [[LTE]] signaling、LTE-DTC / direct-to-cell communication、LTE measurements。
- [[NB-IoT]] / NB-NTN signaling。
- [[WLAN]] signaling 與 WLAN TX measurements，涵蓋 802.11a/b/g/n/ac、802.11ax、802.11be、802.11bn 與 2x2 MIMO。
- [[Fading]]、[[AWGN]]、[[BLER]]、[[CSI report]]、[[Throughput measurement]]、[[PER measurement]]。
- Application test、IP traffic analysis、IMS / audio / [[POLQA]]。
- GUI、graphical scripting、Python-based [[XLAPI]] 與 [[SCPI]] remote control。

R&S CMP180 › Transmitter test functions
- 8 input signals to be multiplexed to RF analyzer no. 1。
- 8 input signals to be multiplexed to RF analyzer no. 2。
- frequency-dependent attenuation（FDA）tables for user-specific corrections，分別對 RF 1.1 to RF 1.8 與 RF 2.1 to RF 2.8。

CMX500 Callbox › Callbox 定位
依 [[CMX500_Callbox]]，callbox 的核心敘事是：

- Easy to set up。
- Easy to get in a call。
- Easy to test with。
- Focus on [[RF Testing]]，including [[3GPP pre-conformance]]。

來源以 [[Device Under Test]]、cell tower 與 smartphone 圖示描述 [[R&S CMX500]] 作為 DUT 連線與測試環境的中心。

Regulatory test for wireless devices with cellular technology › 與既有知識的關係
- 補強 [[5G NR SAR testing]]：既有頁以 [[SPEAG]] / [[DASY8-3D]] / [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] 的 SAR automation PR 為主；本來源從 CE RED Art 3.1a / FCC SAR / HAC compliance presentation 的角度補入 5G NR network emulator、multi-radio UE、average-SAR 與 CMW/CMX signaling solution。
- 補強 [[R&S TS9975 EMI Test System]]：既有頁只由 [[2025RS Drone Solution]] 支撐 TS9975 作為 UAV EMI system；本來源新增 wireless devices Art 3.1b EMC / ABT context，並與 [[R&S TS9982 EMS Test System]] 同列。
- 連接 [[低軌衛星終端設備檢測]]與 [[衛星地球電臺設備技術規範]]：既有頁以台灣 111年08月衛星地球電臺設備草案與 FCC Part 25 對應為主；本來源提供更泛化的 CE RED / ETSI EN 301 681 / EN 303 981 / FCC CFR47 §25 mobile satellite service 視角。
- 與 [[R&S CMW500]] 既有頁相容：既有頁已保存 CMW500 的 NGeCall / LTE capability 與 datasheet；本來源只是簡報層級稱 latest CMW500 SW supports 3GPP R17 NB-NTN signalling，未提供 software version、license 或 test case ID，不應覆蓋正式 datasheet。
- 與 [[R&S SMBV100B]] 既有頁相容：既有頁是 Version 13.01 specifications；本來源只是把 SMBV100B列為 EN 301 681 / EN 303 981 測試中的 signal generator solution，不新增產品規格。

passages.text:
R&S TS9982 EMS Test System › 來源中的角色
依 [[Regulatory test for wireless devices with cellular technology]]：

- [[R&S TS9982 EMS Test System]] 與 [[R&S TS9975 EMI Test System]] 同列於 Traditional EMC Art 3.1b tests。
- 上下文是 [[CE RED 無線設備法規測試]] Art 3.1b [[EMC]] requirements。
- 來源指出 Art 3.1b EMC test requirements are not changed by 5G NR。
- EMC tests need both enable radio and disable radio conditions, which means signaling solution for 5G NR。
- Mobile phones require [[Audio Breakthrough]] test, from GSM to VoLTE and VoNR by 5G。
- 來源稱 R&S EMC Systems cover 5G NR functionality, powered by latest [[R&S CMX500]]。

Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024 › 關鍵實體與概念
- [[Rohde & Schwarz]]：新聞稿發布者與測試解決方案供應商。
- [[Rohde & Schwarz GmbH & Co KG]]：frontmatter author 與 R&S registered trademark 所屬公司名。
- [[R&S CMX500]]：R&D single-box signaling tester；本來源新增 Wi‑Fi 7 test functionality、WLAN offloading、N3IWF 與 POLQA voice quality measurement 的 PR 語境。
- [[R&S CMP180]]：production / R&D non-signaling tester；本來源宣稱支援 Wi-Fi 6E、Wi-Fi 7、5G NR FR1 up to 8 GHz、bandwidths up to 500 MHz，並展示 480 MHz WLAN waveform loopback。
- [[Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing]]：本來源的主題概念，區分 CMX500 R&D signaling 與 CMP180 production non-signaling 測試。
- [[WLAN offloading with Voice over WLAN]]：本來源描述的 CMX500 single-box interworking / voice continuity 測試情境。
- [[Wi-Fi 7]] / [[IEEE 802.11be]]：來源列出 320 MHz channel bandwidth、up to 16 spatial streams、4096 QAM、低延遲與 high throughput。
- [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]]：來源稱 yet-to-be-defined，且 wider channel bandwidths are in discussion；CMP180 480 MHz waveform 被稱為 potential waveform candidate。
- [[MLO]]：Wi-Fi 7 key feature，使 multiple RF chains 的 test environment 變重要。
- [[N3IWF]]：Non-3GPP Interworking Function gateway；來源稱 newly integrated in R&S CMX500。
- [[POLQA]]：來源稱 R&S CMX500 integrated POLQA voice quality measurement function 可用於 Voice over WLAN applications。
- [[MWC 2024]]：展示場合。
- [[Christian Mokry]]：Press & media contact。

passages.text:
R&S CMP180 › Receiver test functions
- RF generator signal is split and forwarded to 8 output ports each。
- every output can be switched off separately。
- collective output level setting for connectors RF 1.1 to RF 1.8 and RF 2.1 to RF 2.8。
- frequency-dependent attenuation（FDA）table for user-specific corrections，分別對 RF 1.1 to RF 1.8 與 RF 2.1 to RF 2.8。

R&S TS9975 EMI Test System › 使用限制
- 本頁只記錄 Market 類簡報中的系統列名；不是 Productions 類 datasheet。
- 不可由 [[2025RS Drone Solution]] 推論 [[R&S TS9975 EMI Test System]] 可覆蓋所有 drone standards 或所有 frequency ranges。
- 不可由 [[Regulatory test for wireless devices with cellular technology]] 推論 TS9975 可覆蓋所有 CE RED Art 3.1b EMC tests、所有 5G NR bands、所有 [[Audio Breakthrough]] configurations 或所有 mobile phone categories。
- 正式規格、可報價配置、標準 coverage、receiver / chamber / antenna / software / CMX500 option stack 需由產品手冊或 R&S configuration source 補證。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing
[[Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]] 中描述的測試方案組合：以 [[R&S CMX500]] 覆蓋 R&D signaling / interworking 測試，以 [[R&S CMP180]] 覆蓋 production non-signaling RF 測試。

Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024 › 重點摘要
- [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 將在 [[MWC 2024]] 展示最新 [[Wi-Fi 7]] R&D 與 production 測試方案，用於應對 [[Wi-Fi 7]] / [[IEEE 802.11be]]、[[LTE]] 與 [[5G]] parallel operation 的測試挑戰。
- [[R&S CMX500]] 被描述為 multi-technology multi-channel signaling tester，新增 integrated [[Wi-Fi 7]] test functionality，可讓 R&D engineers 以 single instrument setup 測試 cellular 與 non-cellular standards。
- [[R&S CMX500]] 的 Wi‑Fi 7 R&D 測試情境包含 signaling mode、real-world RF TX/RX characteristics、[[MLO]]、multiple RF chains、2x2 [[MIMO]]、6 GHz band with out-of-band discovery、coexistence 與 E2E test capabilities。
- [[R&S CMX500]] 也被用於展示 cellular [[5G]] 與 [[WLAN]] 的 traffic offloading / interworking；來源稱其 newly integrated [[N3IWF]] gateway 可測試 [[WLAN offloading with Voice over WLAN]]，並搭配 integrated [[POLQA]] voice quality measurement。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 被描述為 production phase 的 non-signaling RF measurement tester，支援 cellular 與 non-cellular technologies，包括 [[Wi-Fi 6E]]、[[Wi-Fi 7]] 與 [[5G NR FR1]] up to 8 GHz，bandwidths up to 500 MHz。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 將在 MWC 展示 loopback mode 驗證 **480 MHz bandwidth** 的 [[WLAN]] waveform；來源稱這是 yet-to-be-defined [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]] 的 potential waveform candidate。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 來源說法：two analyzers、two generators、two sets of eight RF ports integrated，可在 single box 支援 2x2 [[MIMO]] testing；兩台 CMP180 可 combined / scaled，支援 four analyzers and generators，用於 4x4 MIMO access points。

依 [[Regulatory test for wireless devices with cellular technology]]：

- 在 cellular technology RF test for radio spectrum Art 3.2 投影片中，[[R&S TS8996]] 與 RSE test case 同列。
- 來源寫 Radiated Spurious Emissions measurement up to 200 GHz for FCC for 5G FR2 with high sensitivity of -40 dBm/MHz。
- 來源同頁列出 special signaling、conditioning for carrier、all standards support。
- 在 [[EN 303 981]] 測試投影片中，[[R&S ELEKTRA]] 與 TS8996 RSE & customization 同列。
- 在 FCC CFR47 §25 Mobile Satellite Service 投影片中，[[R&S ELEKTRA]] 與 TS8996 RSE & customization 同列。

依 [[RSE Test System TS8996 (1)]]（07/2025）：

- 簡報標題為 `Radited Spurious Emission (RSE) Test System TS8996`，頁尾日期標示 07/2025；`Radited` 為原文拼字。
- TS8996 的 basic RSE test solution 適用 2G / 3G / 4G / 5G FR1 / WLAN / BT DUTs with radio functionality。
- Basic setup 類似 commercial EMI test，可用 FAR with azimuth and optional elevation scan，也可用 SAC with height scan。
- 基本 frequency range 為 **30 MHz to 12.75 / 26 GHz / 40 GHz**。
- 測試可用 spectrum analyzer，或 spectrum analyzer 搭配 test receiver。
- Test distance 標示為 **3 m**，或為 improved sensitivity 使用 **1 m**。
- 系統需求包含 high sensitivity、stable radiated radiocommunication link、signal conditioning、full automation by [[R&S ELEKTRA]]。
- 來源稱可作 turnkey solution，也可與 EMC test system 或 regulatory test system（[[R&S TS8997]]）combination / extension。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › Production：R&S CMP180 non-signaling RF testing
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]]：

- WLAN device production phase 中，所有 RF measurements 以 non-signaling mode 執行以節省時間。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 被定位為 optimized for this purpose 的 radio communication tester。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMP180]] 支援 many cellular and non-cellular technologies，包括 [[Wi-Fi 6E]]、[[Wi-Fi 7]] 與 [[5G NR FR1]] up to 8 GHz，bandwidths up to 500 MHz。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 將展示 loopback mode 驗證 **480 MHz bandwidth** 的 [[WLAN]] waveform。
- 來源稱 480 MHz WLAN waveform 是 yet-to-be-defined [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]] 的 potential waveform candidate；這不是正式 Wi‑Fi 8 規格。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMP180]] integrated two analyzers, two generators and two sets of eight RF ports，可在 single box 支援 2x2 [[MIMO]] testing。
- 來源稱 two [[R&S CMP180]] instruments can be combined and scaled to support four analyzers and generators for efficient testing of 4x4 [[MIMO]] access points。
•  Virtual tester: an agentic workflow that spans implementation → test → debug → validation, not a

During the development of WLAN devices, measurements of the RF TX and RX characteristics must be conducted under real-world conditions in signaling mode. The R&S CMX500 one-box tester is a multi-technology multi-channel signaling tester that is now available with integrated Wi-Fi 7 test functionality. Especially in Wi-Fi 7 where Multi-Link-Operation (MLO) is a key feature, a test environment that provides multiple RF chains is crucial. The tester's flexibility, support for multiple radio technologies, and embedded IP test capabilities make it a versatile solution for a wide range of Wi-Fi 7-specific tests, such as 2x2 MIMO, 6 GHz band with out-of-band discovery, coexistence and E2E test capabilities.

answer.text:
Short answer: In an RFIC validation workflow, a Signaling Tester fits the R&D validation / system-level RF verification stage, while a Non-signaling Tester fits fast RF measurement / production-oriented verification; the passages do not directly state a semiconductor-specific RFIC workflow, so this mapping is an inference from the documented R&D and production tester roles. [1][5][17][24]
| Tester type | Role in workflow | Workflow stage | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| Signaling Tester, e.g. R&S CMX500 | Establishes a DUT connection like a callbox / network emulator and supports RF, mobility, application, pre-conformance, and R&D validation use cases. | R&D validation, device bring-up, real-world RF TX/RX validation, pre-conformance preparation. | CMX500 is positioned as a callbox to quickly establish DUT connection for RF, mobility, application, pre-conformance, and non-signaling R&D validation. [1] |
| Signaling Tester, e.g. R&S CMX500 | Measures RF TX/RX characteristics under real-world conditions in signaling mode. | R&D validation where the RFIC or wireless device must be tested while operating in a realistic connected state. | Wi-Fi 7 R&D testing uses CMX500 as a multi-technology multi-channel signaling tester, and RF TX/RX measurements are conducted under real-world conditions in signaling mode. [21] |
| Non-signaling Tester, e.g. R&S CMP180 | Performs RF measurements without signaling to save time. | Production phase or fast RF parametric verification stage after R&D validation. | In the WLAN device production phase, all RF measurements are executed in non-signaling mode to save time, and CMP180 is positioned as optimized for that purpose. [24] |
| Non-signaling Tester, e.g. R&S CMP180 | Supports cellular and non-cellular RF testing with analyzers, generators, RF ports, bandwidth, and MIMO scaling. | High-throughput RF validation, characterization, or production test where network emulation is not required. | CMP180 is described as a production-phase non-signaling RF measurement tester supporting Wi-Fi 6E, Wi-Fi 7, and 5G NR FR1 up to 8 GHz with bandwidths up to 500 MHz. [17] |
【推論】For semiconductor RFIC validation, use the Signaling Tester when the RFIC must be validated as part of a connected DUT under realistic network / callbox conditions, because CMX500 is documented for DUT connection, R&D verification, and signaling-mode RF TX/RX testing. [1][5][21]
【推論】Use the Non-signaling Tester when the RFIC validation task is focused on faster RF transmitter / receiver measurements rather than network behavior, because CMP180 is documented for non-signaling RF measurements in the production phase to save time. [17][24]

Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024 › 重點摘要
- [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 將在 [[MWC 2024]] 展示最新 [[Wi-Fi 7]] R&D 與 production 測試方案，用於應對 [[Wi-Fi 7]] / [[IEEE 802.11be]]、[[LTE]] 與 [[5G]] parallel operation 的測試挑戰。
- [[R&S CMX500]] 被描述為 multi-technology multi-channel signaling tester，新增 integrated [[Wi-Fi 7]] test functionality，可讓 R&D engineers 以 single instrument setup 測試 cellular 與 non-cellular standards。
- [[R&S CMX500]] 的 Wi‑Fi 7 R&D 測試情境包含 signaling mode、real-world RF TX/RX characteristics、[[MLO]]、multiple RF chains、2x2 [[MIMO]]、6 GHz band with out-of-band discovery、coexistence 與 E2E test capabilities。
- [[R&S CMX500]] 也被用於展示 cellular [[5G]] 與 [[WLAN]] 的 traffic offloading / interworking；來源稱其 newly integrated [[N3IWF]] gateway 可測試 [[WLAN offloading with Voice over WLAN]]，並搭配 integrated [[POLQA]] voice quality measurement。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 被描述為 production phase 的 non-signaling RF measurement tester，支援 cellular 與 non-cellular technologies，包括 [[Wi-Fi 6E]]、[[Wi-Fi 7]] 與 [[5G NR FR1]] up to 8 GHz，bandwidths up to 500 MHz。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 將在 MWC 展示 loopback mode 驗證 **480 MHz bandwidth** 的 [[WLAN]] waveform；來源稱這是 yet-to-be-defined [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]] 的 potential waveform candidate。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 來源說法：two analyzers、two generators、two sets of eight RF ports integrated，可在 single box 支援 2x2 [[MIMO]] testing；兩台 CMP180 可 combined / scaled，支援 four analyzers and generators，用於 4x4 MIMO access points。
- 展示地點：Fira Gran Via, Barcelona，hall 5，booth 5A80。
- Press & media contact：[[Christian Mokry]]，PR Manager Test & measurement。
- 公司段落稱 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 在 2024/2025 fiscal year（July to June）net revenue 為 EUR 3.16 billion，且 2025-06-30 有 more than 15,000 employees worldwide。
